name: kitchen-tools
description: Free kitchen and restaurant guidance for every role, with transparent calculations, reports and clean menu templates.

interface.longDescription: Free MIT workflows for cooks, bakers, dishwashers, service teams, managers, owners and home cooks. Explain, guide, calculate, create and review with explicit sources and capability limits. Open Kitchen Toolkit is a discovery alias. AI-provider requirements still apply.
defaultPrompt: Show me how to use Open Kitchen Toolkit, one step at a time.
Help me cost my menu and check it against my own margin targets.
Help me organize my recipes and make their units consistent.
